scientific_integrity: Complete analytical proof for axial centroid components only; exact rational-moment verification and independently evaluated Simpson quadrature supplement, not replace, the proof. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Applies to right homothetic frusta with tangential polytope bases and Euclidean ball bases; no full-vector equality or uniqueness of interior taper minimizer. Potential unindexed historical centroid calculations remain.
title: A universal axial surface–volume centroid transition for tangential frusta
